name: invhilb
expr: I4 = invhilb(4); I6 = invhilb(6); I8 = invhilb(8);
comment: Sig: H = invhilb(N). Closed-form inverse Hilbert matrix via the binomial formula H⁻¹[i,j] = (-1)^(i+j)*(i+j-1)*C(n+i-1,n-j)*C(n+j-1,n-i)*C(i+j-2,i-1)². Long-double accumulation delays overflow. Bit-identical-ish with MATLAB R2025b (tol 1e-6 -- both engines lose ULPs through the same overflow-prone formula at N>=8).
